usage: 收身 is mainly used as a noun referring to the process of getting in shape or slimming down.
You can use 收身 to talk about fitness goals or activities aimed at improving body shape.
It often appears with verbs like 做 (to do) or 去 (to go), for example, 做收身計劃 (do a fitness plan).
Though a noun, it can be used in casual conversation like '我想做收身' to express the intention to get fit.
Sometimes, people use 收身 as a short form for 收身運動 (exercises to get in shape).
